# So That Every Citizen Can Vote

<!-- STEP id="symbols" -->
## A Picture Beside Each Name

Not every citizen can read. So each party or candidate has an election **symbol**, a picture on the ballot paper or voting machine. Real symbols are pictures of everyday things. These three are made up for this example.

Try it: she wants the triangle. Press the button beside it.

<!-- STEP id="within-reach" -->
## A Polling Station Within Reach

Polling stations are set up in mountains, forests, deserts and on islands. In some cases one is created even for a single voter, as in the Gir forest.

**Symbols help a voter choose, and nearby stations help a voter arrive.**
